coordination.notion_agent_current_narrow_work: dynamic reservation/session wiring and transport provenance in ordinary Responses path

coordination.why_nonduplicative: Both findings sit at cancellation/tool-outcome boundaries between existing lifecycle/tool-loop and durable retry safety, not in those workers current narrow edits.

candidate_contract: Explicit cancellation after a mutating tool has been admitted is not proof that the tool did not run.
Keep that delegated identity blocked as uncertain until explicit reconciliation/retry, or let the admitted child settle and durably record its outcome before releasing identity.
Do not treat asyncio.CancelledError as an ordinary retryable child failure.
observed_contract: SubagentLifecycle.run_many cancels unfinished child tasks when the parent batch is cancelled and then always releases all reserved task_ids.
DelegatedToolLoopSession awaits the local tool executor directly and catches Exception, but asyncio.CancelledError escapes that handler.
Cancellation can therefore happen after a local write/shell side effect but before function_call_output is appended; the child identity then becomes immediately reusable.

candidate_contract: Tool failures need provenance: deterministic pre-execution/precondition failure versus post-start/ambiguous outcome.
For bash/write_file/edit_file/append_file, a post-start ambiguous failure must escape runTurn as an uncertain coding-turn failure so persisted batch state blocks automatic retry.
Only deterministic failures that provably happened before the mutating operation should be returned to the model as ordinary correctable tool errors.
observed_contract: agent.runTurn emits a mutating tool event before execution, so subagent side-effect state knows the turn may have side effects.
tool-executor catches handler exceptions and returns Error text; bash nonzero/timeout also returns Error text after the process may already have changed state.
agent.runTurn converts that Error text into tool_result and continues the same model loop instead of throwing, so the persisted subagent uncertain guard is never engaged.
The model may retry the same bash/write/edit action even though the prior failing attempt may already have produced a side effect.
